title: Haim Eshed's galactic federation and Mars program claims

tellings.quote: His name is Heim Esed. He said that there's a galactic federation and there's a space program involving people on Mars.

plain: A man from Israel named Haim Eshed has claimed that a galactic federation exists, and that there is a space program with people on Mars. Michels brings this up himself on the show, pointing to Eshed's own background as the reason the claim drew notice, since it would mean a hidden off-world program run alongside contact with other beings.
